decisions.reason: As a flagship product shown on the home page and tied to the firm's announced direction, management is very likely to continue backing it rather than admit a visible strategic mistake.
It extends the firm's core workflow and messaging offer and had its own page, so prior investment and some public commitment make withdrawal unlikely.
Although only mentioned on the website, it still fits the firm's multichannel communications base, so management would tend to retain it absent clear evidence of failure.
This is a relatively small, close-in feature with limited public commitment, but its fit with existing fax-heavy customer processes still favors keeping it for now.
Security is central to the firm's value proposition, so even with limited website prominence management is likely to persist with this protective add-on.
The product is near the established security offer and likely inexpensive to maintain relative to the firm's platform, which supports continued commitment despite modest visibility.
